test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 2 Feb 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In which of the following countries will breakdance make its debut as an official sport in Olympics 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**France**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Breaking is a competitive form of breakdancing which will be an Olympic sport in Paris 2024.
 
• Before this, breakdancing was introduced at the 2018 Youth Olympics in Buenos Aires. 
 
• Athletes, known as b-boys and b-girls will compete for the ultimate sporting prize, a place on an Olympic podium.
 
• Breakdancing mainly consists of four kinds of movement:
 
 
• Toproc
 
• Downrock
 
• Power moves
 
• Freezes
 
 
 
• Four sports proposed by the Paris 2024 Organising Committee have been confirmed:
 
 
• Skateboarding 
 
• Sport climbing
 
• Surfing 
 
• Breaking​​
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **About 2024 Summer Olympics:​**

 
 
• Host city:** Paris, France**
 
• Opening:** 26 Jul 2024**
 
• Closing: **11 Aug 2024**
 
• Events: **329 in 32 sports**
 
• Stadium: **Stade de France**
 
• Motto:** Made for sharing French: Venez partager​**
 
 

118:T1
